note: UI text that scripts/assemble-content.js cannot find safely by pattern: single words, lower-case phrases, and text around ${...} holes. Each entry is an exact snippet of the file (src) and the text inside it that is translated (en). assemble-content.js fails if a src is not in its file, so a code change cannot leave an entry silently stale. build-locale-pages.js replaces every occurrence of src in the French and Portuguese copies, with en swapped for its translation. html: true means src holds en HTML-escaped. See docs/translation-notes.md.
